{{Quote|So he gets to the boiling point, and then he pops like the cork on bad Tatooine wine."<br />"All Tatooine wine is bad.|Wes Janson and Wedge Antilles|<ref name="Wraith">''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''</ref>}}
'''Tatooine wine''' was a beverage from [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] that was kept in corked containers. [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Wes Janson/Legends|Wes Janson]] told fellow pilot [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] that another pilot, [[Kell Tainer]], had the potential to pop like the cork on bad Tatooine [[Wine/Legends|wine]], to which Antilles replied that all Tatooinian wine was bad.<ref name="Wraith" />
